title: Tech Note: 4D View Splitters
author: Gou Yang
featured_technology: PV ADD HOR SPLITTER / PV ADD VERT SPLITTER
PV REMOVE HOR SPLITTER / PV REMOVE VERT SPLITTER
PV SET HOR PANE PROPERTY / PV SET VERT PANE PROPERTY
PV Get area property / PV Get row height / PV Get column width
Locked scrollbars/splitters for frozen header-like panes

historical_commentary.text: This note documents 4D View plug-in commands for a spreadsheet-style pane/splitter UI that has since been retired from 4D's supported toolset — the 4D View plug-in was deprecated and removed as native List Box form objects (with their own built-in frozen-column and frozen-row support) matured and became the standard way to build grid/spreadsheet-like interfaces in 4D. The PV_ADD/REMOVE/SET SPLITTER commands themselves are not applicable to current 4D form objects, making this note of historical interest only for developers maintaining very old 4D View-based databases.
related_updates: The 4D View plug-in has been discontinued; current 4D form development uses native List Box objects, which have their own built-in frozen-row/frozen-column support
Developers still maintaining legacy 4D View-based databases would need the discontinued plug-in to use the PV_ splitter commands documented in this note
